name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
description: Hinged forward with your upper arms tucked by your sides, straighten your elbows to push the dumbbells back.

source.title: Triceps Kickback (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back, knees soft.
Lift your elbows so your upper arms are along your sides.
cues: Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.

prescription.note: Pick a weight you can lift for every rep with good form. Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Elbows bent
keyframes.cue: Upper arms by your sides, forearms hanging.
